title: Apple Seeds macOS Golden Gate 27.2 Release Candidate to Developers
excerpt: Apple is testing the next macOS Golden Gate update, and developers can download the macOS Golden Gate 27.2 release candidate. The RC comes a week...
content_html:
Monday October 19, 2026 10:28 am PDT by Juli Clover

Apple is testing the next macOS Golden Gate update, and developers can download the ‌macOS Golden Gate‌ 27.2 release candidate. The RC comes a week after Apple released the fourth beta.


Registered developers can download ‌macOS Golden Gate‌ 27.2 by opening up the System Settings app, clicking on General, selecting Software Update, and opting into ‌macOS Golden Gate‌ betas.

‌macOS Golden Gate‌ 27.2 introduces Siri AI in new languages and includes new brightness and volume sliders.

We're expecting ‌macOS Golden Gate‌ 27.2 to launch toward the end of October.

Apple Announces 'Full Disk Access' Changes on macOS Due to AI Agents

In a post on its developer news website today, Apple announced that it will be introducing "additional controls" for the "Full Disk Access" setting on macOS due to new risks posed by AI agents. This announcement comes amid the rise of always-on AI agents like Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots, which have prompted privacy concerns. Apple Releases macOS Golden Gate 27.0.1 With Bug Fixes

Monday September 28, 2026 10:13 am PDT by Juli Clover

Apple today released macOS 27.0.1, the first update to the macOS Golden Gate operating system that came out in mid-September. Mac users can download the new macOS Golden Gate software by using the Software Update section in System Settings. Apple says macOS Golden Gate 27.0.1 fixes unspecified bugs. macOS 27.2 Adds Touch Gestures Ahead of MacBook Ultra

Monday October 5, 2026 2:14 pm PDT by Juli Clover

macOS Golden Gate 27.2 adds code referencing new touch-specific gestures in apps like Safari, Notes, Photos, and Quick Look, a possible sign Apple is preparing to release the rumored OLED touchscreen MacBook, possibly called the "MacBook Ultra."
